mcq_drop.why: oddly worded composite pairs mixing Sultanate and British institutions

patterns: APPSC G1 asks match-the-official-with-duty (Amalguzar = district revenue collector, Bitikchi = accountant, Qanungo = village revenue records, Karkun = crop statistics).
Other PSCs ask the unit hierarchy: district = Sarkar; ascending Pargana-Sarkar-Suba.
UPSC-style statement trap: jagirs neither hereditary nor for judicial/police duties.
App adds Golconda (tarafs, 37 sarkars) for AP tilt and analytical items on jagirdari crisis, somewhat beyond PYQ depth.
